posts.text: The ADHD cycle: Idea → Overwhelm → Avoidance → Panic → Hyperfocus → Burnout → Repeat. Let’s break that.
Some of us didn’t find out we had ADHD—we found out we weren’t broken.
ADHD means your brain starts 5 new projects before finishing breakfast.
My real estate business gives me extra money when I need it
I don’t follow a plan. I create ten and pick one halfway through. This hit.
ADHD means talking about one thing and ending up in ancient history. Drop a 🧠 if you get this.
